ruleDefinitions.name: Permission Check Via Accesschk.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of the "Accesschk" utility, an access and privilege audit tool developed by SysInternal and often being abused by attacker to verify process privileges

sequences.query: ((process_product = RGX("AccessChk$") OR process_description = RGX(".*Reports\\ effective\\ permissions.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\accesschk\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\accesschk64\\\.exe$")) OR process_original_file_name = "accesschk\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*uwcqv\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*kwsu\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*qwsu\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*uwdqs\\ .*")))
